title: Tips from recent hires: Navigate the UnitedHealth Group hiring process
summary: Recent hires at UnitedHealth Group breakdown the hiring process and give you tips along the way.
body_markdown:
### **Step 4. Interview:**


If our recruiting team finds that you’re a good fit, you may be invited to an interview. The interview process will vary by role.


Malathi said she navigated the interviews by "Showcasing commitment to continuous learning and professional development ... I successfully cleared the interview round, which focused on sharing my work experience and the skills I have developed professionally."
